messages:
avery: Quick sync — I'm planning to cut release/1.14 next Tue 09:00 PT. Who can create the release/* branch and confirm backport policy?

mike: I can create the branch Monday morning. Do we want a strict feature-freeze before that?

sophia: Yes — feature freeze = Fri EOD PT. Only critical bugfixes and doc/version bumps after that. :lock: 

avery: Agreed. I'll post the official cutoff in #announcements tomorrow. Also reminder: PRs need a CHANGES entry or they won't be considered for backport.

jordan: For backports — same rule as last time: must have a linked issue with severity, a changelog line, and approval from the release lead (@avery). No breaking API changes allowed.

mike: Got it. I'll run the branch create and post the git command here so people can cherry-pick cleanly.

release-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window on Tue 10:30 PT — if you need a different cut time, say now.

mike: Command I'll run:
```
git checkout -b release/1.14 main
git push origin release/1.14
```
Please don't open PRs directly to that branch; open to main and request a backport PR with the backport label.

sophia: On the cherry-pick process — please include the original commit hash in the PR description and use the title prefix "[backport 1.14]". Saves time during review.

avery: Assigning backport reviewers: @sophia for infra/runtime, @jordan for API surface, @mike for docs/changelog. If you need help resolving conflicts during cherry-pick ping me.

jordan: One question — any exceptions for small infra perf tweaks that touch config? Might be risky to backport.

avery: If it's just tuning and has a regression test and no schema change, we can consider. Must get +1 from infra review and pass e2e.

ci-bot: CI note: branch protection will require 2 reviewers and green tests before merge to release/1.14. Backport PRs must be labeled `backport/1.14`.

mike: I'll create the branch at 08:30 PT Monday, post the forked branch name, and open a tracking issue with a checklist.

sophia: I'll start triaging backport requests as they come in. If anyone expects a large backport set, flag it now so we can schedule conflict time.

avery: Thanks — small checklist for everyone: add CHANGES entry, include original commit hash, add `backport/1.14` label for the PR, and tag release lead for approval. I'll post a one-line cutoff reminder Fri 16:00 PT. :calendar:
